headline: Ramayana Day 23: ₹8.45 Cr India nett
lede: Ramayana on Day 23 (Saturday, 28 November 2026) is at ₹8.45 Cr India nett and ₹10.10 Cr India gross, -12.4% from Day 22's ₹9.65 Cr. The board has 6,584 shows at 22.1% occupancy. Trade notes mention advance bookings, but no separate booking total is published here. The day is still open, so this is not the final figure.
body:
Through Day 23 the desk has Ramayana at ₹1,009.0 Cr India nett, ₹1,195.1 Cr India gross, ₹595.0 Cr overseas and ₹1,790.1 Cr worldwide. Adding the day-wise nett rows gives ₹1,000.55 Cr, which is a different series from that lifetime nett, so the two are not combined. Behind it on the daily chart, Yeh Prem Mol Liya at ₹4.00 Cr and Gunmaaster G9 at ₹3.65 Cr. This day's overseas figure is not in, so it is not used to move the worldwide total.

Trade coverage is still led by Ramayana. The Indian Express is citing about ₹1,800.0 Cr, The Week is citing about ₹1,200.0 Cr. The desk keeps ₹1,009.0 Cr India nett and ₹1,790.1 Cr worldwide, and does not blend those reports into its own total. No producer-certified total is included.
